scenes.image: Wide shot down the aisle of a packed chapel, the bride and groom at the altar in soft morning light.
lines: [low, deliberate] The bride had told everyone her father was dead.
sfx: Gentle wedding string quartet in a stone chapel, guests whispering

scenes.image: The minister at the altar, open book in his hands, looking out at the guests.
lines: [warm, ceremonial] If anyone here knows of a reason these two should not be joined in marriage... [pause] speak now.

scenes.image: The heavy carved wooden chapel doors swinging open, daylight pouring in behind a lone figure.
sfx: Heavy old church doors creaking open, echo in a stone hall
scenes.motion: the heavy doors swing open and light floods into the aisle

scenes.image: Thomas standing alone at the back of the aisle in a worn jacket, light behind him, every guest turning.
lines: [clear, steady, carrying across the chapel] I do.
sfx: String music stopping abruptly, a crowd gasping

scenes.image: Olivia at the altar in her wedding dress, turning, her bouquet slipping in her hands, face drained of color.
scenes.motion: she turns slowly toward the doors, her bouquet trembling

scenes.image: Ethan at the altar in a tuxedo, jaw tight, eyes narrowing at the back of the chapel.
lines: [low, through his teeth] Who the hell is that?
[walking slowly down the aisle] My name is Thomas Reed. [pause] I'm the bride's father.

scenes.image: Front pew: Catherine gripping James's arm, staring at the aisle as if she has seen a ghost.
lines: [barely audible] Ethan told me he was dead. [pause] I printed his name in the program.

scenes.image: Close-up of a wedding program on a pew, the words 'In Loving Memory' printed above a name.
lines: [slow] Two hundred guests were holding a wedding program with his name in it. [pause] Under the words: In loving memory.

scenes.image: Olivia stepping toward the aisle; Ethan catching her wrist hard.
lines: [shaking, pleading] Dad, please. You have to leave. [pause] Because if you stay...
[quiet, cold, gripping her wrist] Olivia. Don't say another word.

scenes.image: Thomas halfway down the aisle, stopping, eyes locked on Ethan's hand around Olivia's wrist.
lines: [very quiet, dangerous] Take your hand off my daughter.

scenes.image: Close-up of Thomas's weathered face, eyes wet but steady.
lines: [low] To understand how a living man ended up in his own memorial... we have to go back six months. [pause] To a phone call in a garage.

scenes.image: Six months earlier: Thomas leaning into the engine of an old sedan, wrench in hand, sleeves rolled up.
lines: [straining, muttering to the car] Come on, old girl. One more turn.
sfx: Garage ambience, a wrench clinking, old radio playing soft rock

scenes.image: Thomas stepping back from the sedan as the engine catches, wiping his hands on a rag, grinning.
sfx: An old car engine sputtering then starting and idling
scenes.motion: he steps back from the running engine and wipes his hands on a rag

scenes.image: A small crowded Philadelphia garage wall: faded photos of a little girl in a school play, a graduation cap, all pinned beside the tool pegboard.
lines: [warm] Thomas Reed had spent thirty-five years fixing cars in the same small Philadelphia garage. He wasn't wealthy. His work shirts always smelled like motor oil.

scenes.image: Close-up of an old faded photo of Thomas holding a little girl on his shoulders at a fair.
lines: But he had raised Olivia alone after her mother died. He worked weekends to pay her college tuition. He never missed a school play, a graduation, or a birthday. [pause] Then Olivia met Ethan Blackwood. [pause] And everything changed.

scenes.image: Thomas answering an old phone with a greasy hand, face lighting up.
lines: [a tired sigh] Dad, don't call me that.
[sheepish laugh] Sorry. Old habit. [pause] How's my favorite daughter?
sfx: Old phone ringing in a garage

scenes.image: Olivia on a phone call by a tall window in a sleek apartment, smiling faintly despite herself.
lines: [small smile in her voice] I'm your only daughter.
[hesitant] Dad... I need to tell you something.

scenes.image: Thomas turning down the radio, suddenly worried.
lines: [stunned, then overjoyed] He did? [laughs] Olivia, that's wonderful!

scenes.image: Olivia looking down at a large diamond ring on her hand, not smiling.
Thomas sitting down on an overturned bucket, grinning, phone at his ear.
lines: [warm, certain] Well, whenever it is, I'll be there.

scenes.image: Olivia pressing her forehead against the cold window glass.
lines: [chuckling] So am I. I still use a paper calendar.

scenes.image: Thomas's smile fading as he listens.
Thomas looking down at his grease-stained hands.
lines: [trying to lighten it] Well... I can rent a tuxedo.
sfx: Silence, only an idling engine in the background

scenes.image: Close-up of Thomas, phone at his ear, waiting.
lines: [rushed] I have to go. I'll call you later.

scenes.image: Thomas alone in the garage, slowly lowering the phone, the radio silent.
lines: [slow] She didn't call later. Not that night. Not the next. [pause] And for the first time in twenty-nine years, Thomas wondered whether his daughter was ashamed of him.
scenes.motion: he slowly lowers the phone and stares at the floor

scenes.image: Catherine and James Blackwood at a candlelit table, Catherine smiling over her wine glass.
lines: [sweet, probing] Olivia, darling. Tell us about your family.
sfx: Upscale restaurant, glasses clinking, soft piano

scenes.image: Olivia at the table, napkin twisted in her lap, forcing a polite smile.
lines: [polite, careful] There's not much to tell.
[quietly] She passed away when I was young.

scenes.image: Catherine tilting her head with practiced sympathy.
lines: [practiced sympathy] How tragic. [pause] And your father?

scenes.image: Ethan smoothly cutting in, hand on Olivia's shoulder, smiling at his parents.
lines: [smooth, cutting in] Olivia's father isn't in the picture.

scenes.image: Ethan squeezing Olivia's hand on the table a little too tightly.
lines: [gently, firmly] It's a difficult subject, Mom.

scenes.image: James setting down his fork, looking at Olivia over his glasses.
lines: [measured] Well. Family history is important when two families come together.
[pleasant, persistent] No, James has a point. [pause] Olivia, was your father a businessman?

scenes.image: Olivia lifting her chin.
lines: [quickly] He owned a small repair shop.

scenes.image: Catherine's thin polite smile, eyes cold.
Catherine and James exchanging a silent knowing look across the table.
lines: [low] Olivia noticed the look Catherine gave James. [pause] And Ethan noticed Olivia noticing.

scenes.image: Outside the restaurant at night, Olivia stopping on the wet sidewalk, turning on Ethan.
lines: [hurt, keeping her voice down] Why did you tell them my dad wasn't in the picture?
sfx: City street at night, distant traffic, light rain

scenes.image: Ethan stepping close, cupping her face, voice soft.
lines: [soft, reasonable] Olivia, my mother is difficult. I'm trying to make things easier for you.

scenes.image: Olivia pulling back from his hands, eyes wet.
lines: [smiling] And I'm sure he's a wonderful man. [pause] But do you really want my parents judging you before they even know you?

scenes.image: Ethan opening the door of a black car for her.
lines: [small] I don't want to hide him.
[gently] Then don't. [pause] Just let me handle my family.

scenes.image: Thomas under a car on a creeper, only his boots visible, a pair of polished heels stepping into the garage.
sfx: Garage door rattling, footsteps in heels on concrete

scenes.image: Sarah Mitchell standing in the garage bay in a sharp navy suit, briefcase in hand, smiling.
lines: [rolling out, squinting] Sarah Mitchell? [laughs] Well, I'll be damned.

scenes.image: Thomas getting up, wiping his hands, curious.
lines: [teasing] What brings a fancy lawyer to my garage?
sfx: A wrench set down on a metal tray, then silence

scenes.image: Sarah and Thomas facing each other beside a workbench.
lines: Your daughter's engaged to Ethan Blackwood.

scenes.image: Close-up of an old yellowed court file in Sarah's hands labeled with a fifteen-year-old date.
lines: [measured] Do you remember the commercial property dispute fifteen years ago?
[bitter] The one that nearly cost me my garage?

scenes.image: Thomas closing his eyes, shaking his head slowly.
lines: [quiet] James Blackwood's investment company was behind it.
[shrugging it off] That was a long time ago.

scenes.image: Sarah holding up her phone showing an engagement announcement.
lines: [gently] I know. But I saw your daughter's engagement announcement. And I thought you should know.

scenes.image: Thomas looking at the photo of Olivia pinned on the wall.
lines: [firm, protective] Olivia has nothing to do with that old fight.
[sighs] Sarah, I appreciate the warning. But my daughter loves this man. I'm not going to ruin that over something that happened fifteen years ago.

scenes.image: Sarah handing Thomas a business card at the garage door.
lines: [holding his gaze] If anything feels wrong... call me.
scenes.motion: she presses a business card into his hand and walks out into the daylight

scenes.image: Catherine at a table covered with wedding programs and seating charts, Olivia beside her, a grand piano behind.
lines: [brisk, cheerful] Olivia, we need to finalize the wedding program.
sfx: Large quiet mansion room, someone playing soft piano in the next room

scenes.image: Catherine running a manicured finger down a printed schedule.
lines: [casually] Ethan mentioned your father wasn't around.

scenes.image: Olivia setting down a seating chart, uneasy.
lines: [patting her hand] Darling, you don't need to explain. Some people have unfortunate family circumstances.

scenes.image: Olivia pulling her hand away; Catherine smiling serenely.
lines: [firm] My father is a good man.

scenes.image: Close-up of Olivia freezing, staring at Catherine.
lines: [surprised] Ethan told me he passed away.

scenes.image: Olivia going pale, gripping the edge of the table.
lines: [soothing] Oh, dear. I hope I haven't upset you.

scenes.image: Catherine holding up a cream-colored wedding program proudly.
lines: [delighted] We'll include a small tribute in the program. [reading softly] In loving memory of Thomas Reed. [pause] Wouldn't that be beautiful?

scenes.image: Close-up of an elegant printed wedding program page: 'In Loving Memory of Thomas Reed, Beloved Father of the Bride'.
lines: [low] Olivia stared at the page. Her father's name. And beneath it: Beloved father of the bride. Forever in our hearts.

scenes.image: Olivia standing up abruptly, the program crumpling in her fist.
lines: [barely controlled] I need to speak with Ethan.
scenes.motion: she stands abruptly, the program crumpling in her hand

scenes.image: Olivia storming into the dark apartment, slamming the crumpled program on the kitchen island.
lines: [furious, shaking] You told your mother my father was dead?
sfx: Apartment door slamming, keys thrown on a counter

scenes.image: Ethan by the window loosening his tie, not even turning around.
lines: [evenly] I told her you lost your father.

scenes.image: Olivia in the middle of the room, tears of anger in her eyes.
Ethan turning from the window, his face expressionless, city lights behind him.
lines: [quiet, matter-of-fact] Because your father is a problem.

scenes.image: Olivia stepping back as if struck; Ethan pouring himself a drink.
lines: [pouring a drink] My father knows who Thomas Reed is. There was a legal dispute years ago.
That had nothing to do with me.

scenes.image: Ethan swirling his glass, eyes hard.
lines: [sharp] It has everything to do with us.
[pleading] Then tell your parents the truth.

scenes.image: Olivia pulling the engagement ring halfway off her finger.
lines: [shaking, determined] I'd rather cancel it than pretend my dad is dead.

scenes.image: Ethan setting down his glass, calm and menacing.
sfx: A phone set down hard on a glass table

scenes.image: Close-up of Ethan's phone on the glass table showing a loan document with signatures.
lines: [casually] Remember the loan you co-signed for our new business?
Your father guaranteed part of it.

scenes.image: Olivia staring at the phone, confused.
lines: [patiently, like explaining to a child] And if the business defaults... the lender goes after the guarantor.

scenes.image: Close-up of Olivia's face as the realization sinks in.
lines: [faltering] You said the company was doing well.
[lightly] It is. [pause] As long as nobody creates problems.

scenes.image: Ethan walking past Olivia, pausing beside her ear.
lines: [whisper] You wouldn't deliberately let him lose his garage.
[softly, at her ear] Then let's not find out.
sfx: Silence, a distant siren far below

scenes.image: Olivia alone by the window, the ring back on her finger, city lights reflected in tears.
lines: [slow] Olivia had just learned the real price of her wedding. [pause] Her father's livelihood.
scenes.motion: she slowly pushes the ring back onto her finger, tears reflecting the city lights

scenes.image: Thomas at a small kitchen table with a small birthday cake, two plates set out, answering the phone hopefully.
sfx: Phone ringing in a quiet kitchen, a clock ticking

scenes.image: Thomas beaming, leaning back in his chair.
lines: [delighted] There she is! [laughs] I was beginning to think you forgot.
[playful] Sixty-two years old. Still handsome. [chuckles] Still can't figure out the TV remote.

scenes.image: Olivia sitting on a sofa in the dark, phone at her ear, holding back tears.
Thomas's smile fading, gently knowing.
lines: [gently] You never were a good liar.
[coaxing] Come by this weekend. I'll make pancakes.

scenes.image: Olivia pressing a hand over her mouth to keep from crying out loud.
Close-up of Thomas staring at the second empty plate.
lines: [quiet, hurt] Olivia... [pause] did I do something?

scenes.image: Olivia crying silently, shaking her head.
lines: [softly] Then why does it feel like I'm losing you?

scenes.image: Olivia curled on a gray sofa, phone pressed to her cheek.
lines: [a broken whisper] Please don't call me that.

scenes.image: Thomas nodding to himself, swallowing.
Thomas alone at the table, one candle burning on a small cake, the second plate untouched.
lines: [slow, heavy] Thomas sat alone beside a birthday cake he'd bought for two. He waited another hour. [pause] Then he put the second plate away.
scenes.motion: the single candle flickers as he slowly picks up the second plate

scenes.image: Mia standing hesitantly at the open garage door, holding a folded piece of paper.
Thomas looking up from a workbench, breaking into a big smile.
lines: [warm surprise] Mia? Well, look at you! [laughs] How's my daughter's favorite troublemaker?

scenes.image: Mia twisting the folded paper in her hands.
lines: Did she tell you about the wedding?

scenes.image: Close-up of Mia, eyes full of pity.
Thomas setting his wrench down very slowly.
Mia unfolding the paper and holding it out to Thomas.
lines: [reluctant] There's something else. [pause] The wedding website... says you passed away.

scenes.image: Close-up of a printed wedding website page held in a grease-stained hand: 'In Loving Memory of Thomas Reed'.
lines: [reading, barely a whisper] In loving memory... of Thomas Reed.

scenes.image: Thomas staring at the page, his hand trembling.
lines: [cracking] My daughter told people I was dead?
[urgent] I don't think it's that simple.

scenes.image: Mia stepping closer, lowering her voice.
lines: [frustrated] I can't. [pause] But I think Ethan is hiding something.

scenes.image: Close-up of Mia, serious and scared.
lines: [low] Because Olivia called me crying last night. [pause] And when I asked what was wrong... Ethan took her phone.

scenes.image: Sarah behind her desk in a downtown law office, files spread out, gesturing for Thomas to sit.
lines: [grim] I need to know what happened fifteen years ago. [pause] All of it.
sfx: Quiet office, city traffic far below, papers shuffling

scenes.image: Close-up of an old site plan map of a city block with a small lot circled in red.
lines: [laying out a map] Your garage sat on land Blackwood Development wanted for a commercial project.
They tried to terminate your lease early. We fought it.

scenes.image: Thomas sitting across the desk in a flannel shirt, arms crossed.
lines: We settled. Your lease was protected, with renewal rights.
[frowning] Then why would they care about me now?

scenes.image: Sarah sliding a new stack of filings across the desk.
lines: [carefully] Because the Blackwoods are buying up the neighboring lots again.

scenes.image: Close-up of a public business filing with the name 'Ethan Blackwood' listed as managing member.
lines: [pointing] The newest development company on that block? It belongs to Ethan.

scenes.image: Close-up of Thomas, the pieces falling into place.
lines: [slowly, horrified] So he knew who I was... before he ever met Olivia?

scenes.image: Thomas standing up, pulling on his jacket.
lines: [resolved] Then I need to talk to my daughter.
I'm not going there to fight.

scenes.image: Thomas at the office door, looking back at Sarah, eyes wet.
lines: [voice thick] Because my little girl is getting married. [pause] And somebody convinced her that her father had to be dead for that to happen.

scenes.image: The night before the wedding: Olivia throwing clothes into an open suitcase, the wedding dress hanging behind her.
lines: [frantic whisper] Mia, I can't do this.
sfx: Hotel room, suitcase zipper, hangers rattling

scenes.image: Mia sitting on the edge of the bed , arms crossed.
lines: [incredulous] Olivia, your wedding program says your living father is dead. Nothing about this is normal.

scenes.image: Olivia sinking onto the bed beside the suitcase.
lines: [desperate] Ethan says if I leave, he'll let the business fail.
[shaking her head] Dad guaranteed the equipment lease.

scenes.image: Mia leaning in, grabbing Olivia's hands.
lines: [firm] A guarantee doesn't mean Ethan gets to control your life.
[quiet, fierce] What if you marry a man who's already threatening your family?

scenes.image: A hotel door opening; Ethan standing in the doorway in a dark suit.
sfx: Hotel key card beep, door opening

scenes.image: Ethan stepping into the suite, looking at the half-packed suitcase.
lines: [polite, cold] Mia, could you give us a minute?

scenes.image: Close-up of Mia's hand resting on her phone on the dresser; her thumb taps the screen, a small red dot glowing.
lines: [low, almost a whisper] Mia's phone was lying face-up on the dresser. [pause] Nobody noticed her thumb touch the screen.
scenes.motion: her thumb lightly taps the phone screen and a small red dot begins to glow

scenes.image: Ethan shrugging, standing over the suitcase.
lines: [sighs] Fine. [pause] I just came to remind you that tomorrow is the most important day of our lives.
[quiet, bitter] Then why does it feel like a funeral?

scenes.image: Ethan's face hardening.
Olivia standing up to face him, trembling.
lines: [shaking but firm] I'm done discussing it.
[low, slow, every word deliberate] Then think carefully about what happens to his garage.

scenes.image: Mia shooting up from the bed, pointing at Ethan.
lines: [furious] Did you seriously just threaten her father?

scenes.image: Thomas alone in the garage at night under a single work lamp, a phone buzzing on the desk.
sfx: Phone vibrating on a wooden desk, quiet garage at night

scenes.image: Mia in a dark hotel hallway, whispering into her phone, glancing at a closed door.
lines: [low, fast] I need you to listen carefully. Olivia's wedding is tomorrow at eleven. St. Andrew's Chapel.

scenes.image: Close-up of Mia, determined.
Thomas sitting under the work lamp, rubbing his eyes.
lines: [bitter, quiet] Then why did she tell everyone I was dead?

scenes.image: The old garage at night, the work lamp swaying slightly over the car on the lift.
lines: [slowly, dangerously calm] He threatened my daughter... with my garage?
scenes.motion: the hanging work lamp sways gently, shadows moving over the car

scenes.image: Close-up of Thomas, jaw clenched, eyes wet.
lines: [softly] Mia... does she know you're calling?
[barely] Then tell me one thing. [pause] Is she safe?

scenes.image: Mia leaning against the hallway wall, closing her eyes.
lines: [quiet] She's with me. [pause] But I don't think she'll be safe if she marries him.

scenes.image: Thomas picking up Sarah's old business card from the desk and dialing.
lines: [low] When the call ended, Thomas didn't go to bed. He pulled an old business card from the corner of his desk.
[quiet, resolved] Sarah. You said if anything felt wrong, call you. [pause] Can you be at St. Andrew's Chapel tomorrow at eleven?

scenes.image: Back in the chapel: Thomas stopped in the aisle; Ethan still gripping Olivia's wrist at the altar.
lines: [low] Which brings us back to the chapel.
[very quiet] I said, take your hand off my daughter.
sfx: Large crowd murmuring nervously in a stone chapel

scenes.image: Thomas raising his empty hands, calm, guests whispering around him.
lines: [calm, loud enough for everyone] I'm not here to hurt anyone.

scenes.image: James standing up in the front pew, staring hard at Thomas.
lines: [cold, low] You're supposed to be dead.
[evenly] Why? [pause] Because your family told everyone I was?

scenes.image: Olivia at the altar, tears running, unable to look at her father.
Thomas reaching the front of the aisle, looking up at Olivia, voice soft.
lines: [softly] Did you tell them I died?
sfx: Total silence in a large stone chapel

scenes.image: Close-up of Olivia, mascara streaked, nodding.
Ethan stepping between Olivia and Thomas.
lines: [without looking at him] I wasn't talking to you.

scenes.image: Thomas and Ethan face to face at the altar steps.
lines: [low, steady] Then tell everyone why you threatened my daughter.
[smiling for the crowd] I have no idea what you're talking about.

scenes.image: Mia in her bridesmaid dress stepping out of the line of bridesmaids, holding her phone.
Ethan glaring at Mia, pointing at her.
Mia looking at Olivia, eyes kind but unyielding.
